title.en: Auntie Mitzi and the hearing aid
title.it: La zia Mitzi e l'apparecchio acustico

setting.sl: Teta Mitzi je v Beljaku dobila slušni aparat, a ga ne nosi: piska, srbi jo in zaradi njega se počuti staro. Zdaj posluša radio na vso moč in po telefonu nikogar ne razume. Obiščeš jo in ji svetuješ.
setting.en: Auntie Mitzi got a hearing aid in Villach, but she won't wear it: it whistles, it itches and it makes her feel old. Now her radio is on full blast and she can't understand anyone on the phone. You visit her and give her some advice.
setting.it: La zia Mitzi ha preso un apparecchio acustico a Villaco, ma non lo porta: fischia, le dà prurito e la fa sentire vecchia. Adesso ascolta la radio a tutto volume e al telefono non capisce nessuno. Vai a trovarla e le dai qualche consiglio.

role: Tante Mitzi, seventy-four, the village gossip with her little radio. She has a new hearing aid and won't wear it: it whistles, it itches, and she isn't old. Doubts each piece of advice once ('Wie bitte?', 'Ich bin doch nicht schwerhörig!'), then gives in to a good one. Says du to {learner}.
speaker: grandma

goals.de: Frag, warum sie das Hörgerät nicht trägt
goals.sl: Vprašaj, zakaj ne nosi slušnega aparata
goals.en: Ask why she doesn't wear the hearing aid
Give her at least two pieces of advice
Reassure her when she has doubts

goals.de: Sag, was besser wird, wenn sie es trägt
goals.sl: Povej, kaj bo boljše, če ga bo nosila
goals.en: Say what will get better if she wears it
goals.it: Dille che cosa migliorerà se lo porta

opener_sl: Ah, du bist's! Setz dich. Was schaust du so? Das Hörgerät? Das liegt in der Lade. Das pfeift mir nur in den Ohren!

opener_en.sl: A, ti si! Sedi. Kaj me tako gledaš? Slušni aparat? Ta je v predalu. Samo piska mi v ušesih!
opener_en.en: Ah, it's you! Sit down. Why are you looking at me like that? The hearing aid? It's in the drawer. It only whistles in my ears!
opener_en.it: Ah, sei tu! Siediti. Perché mi guardi così? L'apparecchio? È nel cassetto. Mi fischia solo nelle orecchie!

vocabulary_hints.sl: Warum trägst du das Hörgerät nicht?

en.en: Why don't you wear the hearing aid?

vocabulary_hints.sl: Am Anfang ist das ganz normal.

en.sl: Na začetku je to čisto normalno.
en.en: That's quite normal at the start.

vocabulary_hints.sl: An deiner Stelle würde ich es jeden Tag ein bisschen tragen.

en.sl: Na tvojem mestu bi ga {m:nosil|f:nosila} vsak dan malo.
en.en: If I were you, I'd wear it a little every day.
en.it: Al posto tuo lo porterei un po' ogni giorno.

vocabulary_hints.sl: Du könntest noch einmal zum Akustiker gehen.

en.sl: Lahko bi še enkrat šla tja, kjer si ga dobila.
en.en: You could go back to the hearing-aid shop.

vocabulary_hints.sl: Der kann es so einstellen, dass es nicht pfeift.

en.sl: Tam ga lahko nastavijo tako, da ne bo piskal.
en.en: They can set it so that it doesn't whistle.
en.it: Lì possono regolarlo in modo che non fischi.

vocabulary_hints.sl: Warum probierst du es nicht zuerst zu Hause?

en.sl: Zakaj ga ne poskusiš najprej doma?
en.en: Why don't you try it at home first?
en.it: Perché non lo provi prima a casa?

vocabulary_hints.sl: Dann verstehst du auch am Telefon alles.

en.sl: Potem boš tudi po telefonu vse razumela.
en.en: Then you'll understand everything on the phone too.
en.it: Così capirai tutto anche al telefono.

vocabulary_hints.sl: Das sieht man fast gar nicht.

en.it: Non si vede quasi per niente.

vocabulary_hints.sl: Versprichst du mir, dass du es probierst?

en.sl: Mi obljubiš, da ga boš poskusila?
en.en: Will you promise me you'll try it?
